TRIGGERED_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:SetFilterType( FILTER_TYPE_PLAYERS ) filter:Add( FE_TEAM, OP_NOT, EffectController():GetTeam() )
TRIGGERED_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION:
local targetDC = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0) if targetDC ~= nil then local player = targetDC:Get_PlayerPtr(0) if player ~= nil then local filter = ClearFilter()
filter:Add(FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE) filter:Add(FE_CONTROLLER, OP_IS, player)
local hasCreature = filter:CountStopAt(1)
player:BeginNewMultipleChoice() player:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_ANSWER_INDULGENT_TORMENTOR_DRAW_CARD" ) player:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_ANSWER_INDULGENT_TORMENTOR_SACRIFICE", hasCreature == 1 ) player:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_INDULGENT_TORMENTOR_LOSE_3_LIFE", player:GetLifeTotal() >= 3) player:AskMultipleChoiceQuestion( "MODE_CHOOSE_ONE" ) end end

local player = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_PlayerPtr(0) if player ~= nil then local result = player:GetMultipleChoiceResult()
if result == 0 then EffectController():DrawCards(1) elseif result == 1 then local filter = ClearFilter()
filter:Add(FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE) filter:Add(FE_CONTROLLER,OP_IS, player)
player:ChooseItem( "CARD_QUERY_CHOOSE_CREATURE_TO_SACRIFICE", EffectDC():Make_Chest(1))
elseif result == 2 then player:LoseLife(3) end end

local player = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_PlayerPtr(0) if player ~= nil then local result = player:GetMultipleChoiceResult()
if result == 1 then local sacDC = EffectDC():Get_Chest(1) if sacDC ~= nil then local creature = sacDC:Get_CardPtr(0) if creature ~= nil then player:Sacrifice(creature) end end end end
